{"id":1079081368,"question_id":2917,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 9 months","timestamp":1697709663,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"98 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1079081368/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Pairs Whose Sum is Less than Target","memory":"40.4 MB","code":"public class Solution {\n    public int CountPairs(IList<int> nums, int target) {\n        int res = 0, n = nums.Count;\n        for(int i =0; i < n -1; i++ )\n        {\n            for(int j = i+ 1; j < n; j++)\n            {\n                if(nums[i] + nums[j] < target)\n                {\n                    res++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        return res;\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-pairs-whose-sum-is-less-than-target","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":188}
